info.title: ility API
info.description: Read accessibility results and start scans in your ility workspace.

200.description: The workspaces the caller belongs to, by name

get.description: Lists the workspaces the caller belongs to. An API key only ever sees its own workspace.
Lists the workspace's surfaces with each one's score, open issue count, and last scan.
Returns one surface, including the domain it wraps and that domain's slug.
Lists the websites in the workspace. Use a domain's `slug` with the other domain routes and its `id` to filter issues.
Returns one domain's settings, plan, and entitlements.
Returns the domain's accessibility score and band, open issue counts by severity and WCAG level, page counts, and its last scan.
Lists scan runs for one domain, newest first.

403.description: Forbidden — viewer role, or an API key on a domain whose plan has no programmatic triggers (reason: 'api_triggers_not_entitled')

409.description: Active scan exists for one or more engines

post.description: Queues a scan of the domain's pages and returns one scan run per engine. Omit the body to scan every active page with the domain's own WCAG target and engines. With an API key, the domain's plan must include API triggers, or the request fails with `403` and `reason: api_triggers_not_entitled`.

get.description: Lists scan runs across the workspace, newest first. Filter by `status` (`active` means queued, running, or paused) or by domain slug.
Returns one scan run with its status, page counts, score, and timing. Poll it to follow a scan you started.
Lists the pages in one scan run with each page's result, score, and any failure reason.
Lists issues across the workspace. Without a `status` filter, only open issues are returned. Paginate with `page` and `limit`; `total` counts every match.
Returns one issue with its rule, WCAG criteria, severity, status, assignee, and page and instance counts.

patch.description: Changes an issue's status, assignee, or external link. A status change can carry a short note, which appears on the timeline.

get.description: Lists every place the issue appears: the page, the element's selector, and its markup.
Returns a ready-made prompt that describes the issue, the failing markup, and how to fix it, for a coding assistant working in the site's codebase.

403.description: Forbidden (viewer role, a caller with no member row, or an API key on a domain whose plan has no programmatic triggers: reason 'api_triggers_not_entitled')

post.description: Rescans the pages where the issue appears. With an API key, the domain's plan must include API triggers.

apiKey.description: An ility API key, such as `ilk_1a2b3c4d_…`. Workspace owners create keys under Settings → API keys.
